title: Wire staged load_policy validation over the full accepted config surface
summary: Commit 6b3492e adds staged validation (stages 2a, 2b, 3 and 4) to load_policy in scanner/src/dogwatch/config.py over the full accepted surface. The same commit rewrites scanner/tests/test_config.py to cover every criterion. Commit d067de7 is the operator-authorized option A change to scanner/tests/test_cli.py. In the two tests whose invalid config was a bare [openapi], [openapi] is replaced by the still-unsupported openapi.severity key. The two stage-3 expected lines gain the python.packages[i]: prefix. Nothing else in test_cli.py changes. make test-scanner, make lint-scanner and make test-fixtures all exit 0.
